text: {"batchcomplete":true,"query":{"pages":[{"pageid":265594,"ns":0,"title":"Block and tackle","extract":"A block and tackle, purchase, or only tackle is a system of two or more pulleys with a rope or cable threaded between them, used to provide tension and lift heavy loads.\nThe pulleys are assembled to form blocks and then blocks are paired so that one is fixed and one moves with the load.","description":"System of two or more pulleys and a rope or cable","descriptionsource":"local"}]}}
